# SkoolOfCode

> K-12 live online coding, AI, and robotics education with project-based curriculum from Scratch to AP-level Python and web development.

SkoolOfCode provides structured coding classes for students in grades 1-12, with four curriculum levels (Foundation, Creator, Builder, Professional) taught by experienced instructors. The platform emphasizes hands-on learning through real coding projects, AI tools, and robotics integration.

## Key Topics

- Scratch coding
- Python programming
- AI education
- Robotics
- Web development
- AP exam prep
- Project-based learning
- Kids coding classes
- AI APIs
- GitHub
- Foundation level
- Builder level
- Creator level
- Professional level
- Live online classes

## Curriculum & Programs

- [Curriculum Overview](https://skoolofcode.us/curriculum): Overview of SkoolOfCode's coding curriculum across all levels and tracks
- [Foundation Level](https://skoolofcode.us/curriculum/foundation): Foundation-level Scratch coding program for grades 1-3 beginners
- [Creator Level](https://skoolofcode.us/curriculum/creator): Creator-level curriculum with AI and robotics for grades 4-6
- [Builder Level](https://skoolofcode.us/curriculum/builder): Builder-level Python, AI, and web development for grades 7-9
- [Professional Level](https://skoolofcode.us/curriculum/professional): Professional-level AP exam prep and college-ready coding for high school
